tools.name: compare_construction_options
tools.description: Side-by-side rules for financing apartment construction four ways: HUD 221(d)(4), a bank construction loan, a debt fund and 4% tax credits with bonds. For each: maximum loan size and the rule behind it, rate type, term, coverage test, extra costs and process, with the regulation or HUD letter cited.

tools.name: size_construction_loan
tools.description: Runs the site's construction loan sizer on your project: the HUD 221(d)(4) loan (lower of 87%/90% of cost and the 1.15/1.11 coverage test, with HUD's construction-interest estimate and upfront MIP), the bank regulatory ceiling (80% of value and 15%-of-value HVCRE equity, plus your bank's loan-to-cos

tools.name: get_construction_market
tools.description: Latest U.S. apartment construction numbers for 5+ unit buildings from the Census Bureau (starts, permits, units under construction, completions; seasonally adjusted annual rate, with year-ago and the pipeline peak) and the Federal Reserve's loan officer survey on construction and multifamily lending

tools.name: get_build_timeline
tools.description: Census Survey of Construction averages for apartment buildings: months from permit to start and from start to completion, by U.S. region and building size (5-9, 10-19 or 20+ units), for one completion year with the ten-year trend, plus what the build length means for HUD upfront MIP and construction
